column1: What does a function return if no return statement ever runs?
column2: None — every call hands back something; no return hit → None. (print instead of return is the classic cause.)
return hands a value back (usable, storable, testable); print only paints pixels. The print version returns None.

column1: Phrase for "string contains at least one digit"?
column2: any(ch.isdigit() for ch in pw) — pw.isdigit() asks "is the WHOLE string digits?", the wrong question.

column1: What does any(...) take and give back?
column2: Takes a stream of booleans, gives one: True if at least one is True. Without it you have many answers and no verdict.

column1: Which branch of an if/elif chain runs?
column2: The FIRST true one, top to bottom — the rest are skipped even if also true. Narrowest/highest test first.
4.5, a float — numbers mix freely (int gets promoted); only number-meets-TEXT errors.
